title.narrative: Advancing Women Scientists' Participation and Leadership in Research

description.narrative: UNESCO will support and promote the participation, visibility, and leadership of women scientists in Pakistan, with particular emphasis on strengthening their engagement in scientific research and addressing barriers to their full participation in the scientific community. Through advocacy, awareness raising, networking, mentoring, and knowledge-sharing initiatives, the intervention will encourage greater involvement of women scientists in research, innovation, and evidence generation. The initiative will also promote awareness of the importance of scientific freedom, equitable access to research opportunities, and inclusive scientific environments that enable women scientists to contribute effectively to addressing societal and emerging challenges.
